visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md (locked 2026-08-11). The index.html in this directory is the RETIRED KB-era mockup and is kept only because ci:mockup-coverage requires a parity.json beside any index.html. It is not the visual target for this route any more. The target is the six closed patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3.
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Coldwell Banker / Windermere city pages. The place verdict in the first viewport with its trace and its stamp, the live inventory as a spatial surface directly under it, one low-friction city-scoped alert capture, and every outbound edge the place graph owns. No aggregator publishes the trace under the number, and none of them answer the buyer-or-seller question on the city page at all.
note: Migrated off the KB register onto the v3 barrel 2026-08-12 (P9, Places family). RHYTHM: this route spends FIVE of the six patterns, not four, and that is a declared conflict with PUBLIC_UI.md section 3 rather than an oversight. Order is Breadcrumb, Instrument level 1 (place verdict), Field (inventory), Ledger x3 (neighborhoods, communities, golf and master-planned), Quiet (about + place facts), Sheet (city alert capture), Ledger x3 (live activity, city guides, other cities), Quiet (FAQ + outbound edges), Footer. Four of those patterns are forced: Instrument and Field by section 3's locked Places opening, Sheet by this route's machine objective in page-inventory.json (capture a city-scoped listing alert, and Sheet is the only pattern carrying a form), and Quiet because the FAQPage JSON-LD this route has always emitted requires its questions visible. LEDGER IS THE FIFTH, AND IT IS BACK BECAUSE THE FIRST REVISION OF THIS MIGRATION DEFERRED IT AND DELETED SIX MATT-ISSUED PRODUCT DIRECTIVES WITH IT: the designated-neighborhood set (D83), the separate golf and master-planned section (D85), the city guides (D80), the other-cities exit (D84), the full communities rail (D88), and the live activity feed (D93), each of which is a contract test in components/site/__tests__/site-contracts.test.ts. A rhythm rule is a house style; those six are product decisions with an owner. The ledgers therefore render on the barrel's own V3Ledger primitive rather than on the retired KB sections, so the page carries one visual language and the register ratchet still falls. The remaining cost is that two Ledgers sit adjacent in each of the two ledger runs; that is the declared conflict and it needs a program-wide ruling, not a silent deletion of the sections. MONTHS OF SUPPLY IS CLASSIFIED RAW, THE SAME WAY EVERY OTHER SURFACE CLASSIFIES IT. marketVerdict reads the raw market_pulse_live value, formatMonthsOfSupply renders that same raw value, and buildMarketFaq receives the raw value and runs the identical pair, so /cities/<slug> and /housing-market/<slug> cannot publish opposite verdicts off one row. The inventory count is derived once and printed once, in the Field, from market_pulse_live when that row returned and from getGeoSnapshot when it did not, carrying whichever row's trace and stamp it used; the Instrument never repeats it. A missing pulse row produces no verdict and a stated reason, never a synthesized zero, and every Ledger publishes its value column only when the read behind that column succeeded.

requiredComponents.name: CityPageTracker
requiredComponents.section: Tracking. The view_city GA4 event: city_name, city_slug, listing_count (null when the pulse read degraded, because an unknown count is not a zero), median_price, community_count. COMMUNITY_COUNT IS A CHANGED METRIC, NOT A CHANGED SOURCE FOR THE SAME METRIC — an earlier revision of this contract asserted it was 'the same figure from the row the page already had' and that was false. It is now geo_snapshot_mv.community_count: distinct SubdivisionName values, non-null, not 'N/A', carried by an Active listing in the city, across ALL property types and uncapped (supabase/migrations/20260730003000_geo_snapshot_mv_drop_volatile_split.sql line 119). The retired page sent getCityCommunitySnapshots().length: community rows with active single-family inventory under a LIMIT 40, which on a large city reported the cap rather than a count. TWO POPULATIONS, AND AN EARLIER REVISION OF THIS ENTRY RAN THEM TOGETHER — it cited 'a true uncapped 260' for Bend and then stated the step as 'Bend 40 to 343', two different numbers for one claim in one paragraph. Both were real and neither described the other. Re-verified live 2026-08-12: geo_snapshot_mv.community_count reads Bend 342, Redmond 142, La Pine 63, Sisters 51, Terrebonne 24, Powell Butte 12. Community rows carrying active single-family inventory — the uncapped form of what the retired call counted under its LIMIT 40 — read Bend 259, Redmond 107, La Pine 52, Sisters 37. The uncapped all-types figure is the one kept, and the retired figure is not restored because restoring it would restore a published LIMIT artifact. The GA4 series therefore steps once, at this deploy, from the capped 40 (or the city's row count where it never reached the cap) to that city's community_count. That step is a definition change, not market movement. The figure is ANALYTICS ONLY: no surface on this page renders it, because there is no source line on this page under which it could sit.

requiredComponents.name: KbSectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Page-level analytics, pageType='city'. Kept on the KB register deliberately: section tracking is analytics wiring, not visual language, and the barrel ships no equivalent. ci:kb-page-contract accepts either register's tracker.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > Cities > {City}. Surface tone (this page opens on an Instrument, not a dark Stage), current page never a link. The surface tone also clears the fixed public header by default.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1, once, level 1: the place verdict. Headline is '{City} homes for sale' plus the verdict when there is one, which keeps the money-route head term in the H1 (ci:seo-shell) while making the H1 the answer. Figures are median list price, months of supply, and median days to pending, every one a door, under one trace from market_pulse_live city/{slug}/property_type=A stamped with that row's refreshedAt. The months-of-supply figure is formatMonthsOfSupply(raw) and the verdict beside it is marketVerdict(raw): display and classification read the same untouched value through lib/format/months-of-supply.ts and lib/market/classify.ts, so the printed digits can never cross a threshold the raw value does not cross, and no other public surface can reach a different verdict from the same row. Homes for sale is NOT among them: it is the Field's count, so the page states inventory once. Median days to pending prints the digits buildMarketFaq publishes for the same field (20.5, not a second Math.round to 21 beside a FAQ answer and a Dataset variable reading 20.5 — verified live on /cities/redmond 2026-08-12), and carries the same > 0 guard the other two figures carry, which is that builder's own condition. THE ASK IS A PRIMARY BUTTON into the city browse view. It was a ghost until 2026-08-12 on the stated ground that 'the sticky public header carries a filled valuation CTA at every scroll position' — a FALSE PREMISE, struck here and in the route file. The header's nav-cta is display:none below 880px (components/site/kb/kb.css) and its twin sits inside the collapsed menu, so at 390 that demotion shipped a first viewport with no filled control at all. PUBLIC_UI.md section 1 counts VISIBLE filled controls and requires a content page to carry its own. At 880px and up the header's CTA is a second filled control in the same viewport, which is the chrome unit's conflict to resolve (decisions.md), not a reason for this page to ship no ask. With no publishable figure the Instrument does not render and a V3Quiet at heading level 1 states the reason, and that branch has no filled control above the fold — a declared barrel gap (V3Quiet carries no action by contract) rather than a figure invented to earn an Instrument.

requiredComponents.name: V3Field
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 2, once: live inventory as a spatial surface. The count with its trace and stamp above the frame, the 24 most recently listed active homes as rows that are doors into their listings, and the coordinates plotted. THE COUNT AND THE ROWS ARE NOT THE SAME POPULATION, AND BOTH THE TRACE AND THE FOOT NOTE NOW SAY SO. An earlier revision of this contract and of the route file claimed that filtering the tile pull to propertyType 'A' made them one population. It does not. market_pulse_live.active_count is the Single Family Residence sub-type, StandardStatus Active OR Coming Soon, City equal to the canonical city, and restricted to that city's boundary polygon wherever public.boundaries carries one (verified against refresh_market_pulse(), supabase/migrations/20260526140535_refresh_market_pulse_advisory_lock.sql lines 128-147). The rows are listing_tile_mv filtered to Active by City field across the whole 'A' residential bucket, which mixes single family, townhome, and condo sub-types. Verified live 2026-08-12: Terrebonne 6 against 71 tiles, Bend 489 against 987. The published number is unchanged, because the pulse figure is the canonical one the FAQ answer, the FAQPage JSON-LD, and the Dataset variable all publish, and swapping the Field to a tile-derived count would create the cross-surface contradiction this migration just finished removing. What changed is that the count's source line states its real filter (active and coming-soon single-family homes inside the city boundary, not 'listings with a {City} address', which named neither Coming Soon nor the polygon) and the foot note tells a visitor that the rows beneath are a different measure and not that count's total. THE EMPTY MESSAGE NOW SAYS WHAT THE READ PROVES AND NOTHING WIDER (cityFieldEmptyMessage in _v3/city-sections.ts). It read 'No active single-family listing carried a {City} address on this refresh', which claimed the Single Family Residence sub-type over a propertyType 'A' bucket pull, and claimed an absence in the world where an empty row set only proves that no tile survived cityFieldItems' price-and-street filter. The two states are now different sentences: no tile returned at all, or tiles returned and none carried both a list price and a street. Closing the gap for real needs an address-scoped active total the DAL does not expose to this route; that is a reported data-layer gap, not something this page may resolve by inventing a figure. THE MAP IS REAL: PlaceFieldMap fills the slot when at least one listed row reports coordinates. hasMap returns on the City JSON-LD with that same condition.

requiredComponents.name: PlaceFieldMap
requiredComponents.section: The real Google map in V3Field's mapSlot, shared at app/central-oregon/_v3/PlaceFieldMap.client.tsx. Pins are fieldMapPins(fieldItems): the listed rows that report coordinates. No extra boundary DAL read. Place.hasMap ships when at least one pin plots.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6, twice on the answering render and three times on the stated-absence render, where a level-1 Quiet stands in for the Instrument. THAT THIRD BLOCK IS KEYED ON THIS PAGE'S OWN MARKET READ, NEVER ON THE FIGURE ARRAY: market_pulse_live holds live city rows that RETURN carrying nulls (verified 2026-08-12, geo_slug 'warm springs', property_type 'A', active_count 0 with median_list_price, months_of_supply and median_days_to_pending all null), and keying it on the figures published 'the market row did not return' directly above a Field printing its count under 'the 15-minute market row for Warm Springs'. One page, two contradictory claims about one read. It also states no count of its own and points at the Field's source line instead, and it drops the closing clause about the homes below when there are no rows below. AND NEITHER OF THE OTHER TWO BLOCKS CARRIES A FIGURE — which is now true of the shipped page and was not true of the revision that first claimed it. First: the city in plain words, meaning getCityContent's hand-written description when the city has one, plus the place facts from CITY_QUICK_FACTS, which are the city's own attributes and not market data. buildDataDrivenCityAbout is NOT called from this route (see removedComponents): it emitted live figures inline, so every city without a written description published 'Right now the {City} market shows N active listings, a median list price of $X, N communities and subdivisions' inside a Quiet, with no source line and no stamp — confirmed rendering at /cities/terrebonne before the repair. That sentence restated the inventory count directly under the Field that states it with a trace, reached its median through a fallback chain the traced figure does not use, and published a community count with no trace anywhere on the page. Second: the verified market FAQ as question-and-answer prose from the same buildMarketFaq array the FAQPage JSON-LD uses, followed by every outbound edge this route owns in page-inventory.json (city browse, city market report, open houses, each Bend neighborhood, each registry resort community, the cities index, the valuation spine), plus the Oregon Data Share citation MarketSources used to render and the Census citation whenever a population figure is printed. AND A DECLARED CONFLICT REMAINS IN THE SECOND BLOCK: the market FAQ answers contain numbers, so V3Quiet's own statement that the pattern 'never carries a figure' is not literally true of this page. That is not a repair this route can make. The FAQPage JSON-LD requires its answers to be visible, buildMarketFaq is the single builder feeding the visible copy, the FAQPage items, and the Dataset variables, and the closed six-pattern set has no pattern for verified question-and-answer prose whose answers state figures. The difference from the About block that WAS repaired is not cosmetic: every FAQ answer is a full sentence that names its own basis and its own as-of month ('the median list price for a single-family home in {City} is $X as of {Month}, based on live MLS data'), so each figure travels with its trace, whereas the About sentence carried none. Reported as a pattern-set gap for a program-wide ruling; this contract will not claim the block is figure-free while it is not.

requiredComponents.name: CityAlertSheet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 5, once, in app/cities/[slug]/_v3/CityAlertSheet.client.tsx. The page's one on-page ask and this route's machine objective. Wraps V3Sheet and calls the same server action KbCommunityAlerts called, submitSearchAlertSignup, with the same field name (email) and the same filter map this route always built ({ city, propertyType: 'A' }, no subdivision key). Both success side effects are preserved in order: the F2 guest-watch residual, then the alert_create search event with buildAlertCreatePayload('daily').

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. The canonical sitemap projection (V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS off lib/site-nav) plus the legal row. Carries no button, because the page's one filled control is the opening Instrument's action and a second one at the bottom of the page would be a second primary in that viewport. The retired reason ('the one valuation primary belongs to the sticky header') was the same false premise struck in the V3Instrument entry. Rendered OUTSIDE <main>, because HTML-AAM maps <footer> to role=contentinfo only when it is not nested in sectioning content.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3, SIX times, in two runs. Before the Sheet: the designated Bend neighborhood ledger (D83 - sourced from data/bend/bend-neighborhood-polygons.json, so every designated district is listed even when getBendNeighborhoodLedger omits its zero-inventory row, with a boundary-verified hover photo from assignNeighborhoodPhotos, D89), the full communities rail (D88 - built from every community in getCommunitiesForIndex for this city that has a photo, marquee and Area-Guide-video cards floated to the front, then by active count), and the golf and master-planned ledger (D85 - its OWN section, membership from the is_resort registry, count from resortActiveSfrCounts over the UNCAPPED fetchAllCityActiveSfr set so Widgi reads 48 and not 0, hover photo from RESORT_IMG). After the Sheet: the live activity feed (D93 - 'Latest market activity', every row carrying its listing's own photo through V3Ledger's `media` row prop), the city guides (D80 - real published posts from getRecentBlogPosts, never generated filler), and the other-cities exit (D84 - buildOtherCityItems, which owns the geo_key slugify, the service-area allowlist, and the verified-cityHero-only imagery rule, D86/D87). EVERY ONE OF THE SIX WITHHOLDS ITS VALUE COLUMN RATHER THAN PRINTING A ZERO IT CANNOT VOUCH FOR: a count that could not be measured renders as unmeasured, and the resort count map is EMPTY rather than zero-filled when the uncapped read degraded, which is what makes the fallback chain beneath it reachable at all.

deferredComponents.name: V3Stage
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 4 needs an owned video or photo and is never allowed over a number. PUBLIC_UI.md section 3 opens a Places node on the place verdict, so the first viewport is an Instrument. Adding a Stage would also put this route inside ci:kb-breadcrumb-overlay's dark-hero arm, which would then require the on-media breadcrumb tone.

removedComponents: KbHero (Bend drone video / cityHero photo, the property search field, the voice-search button, the live stat row) - the locked Places opening is the Instrument, and PUBLIC_UI.md forbids a Stage over a number. The hero's stats are the Instrument's figures; its primary CTA is the Instrument's PRIMARY action.
PlaceMapListSplit + KbListingMap - replaced by V3Field with PlaceFieldMap in the map slot. hasMap returns on the City JSON-LD when at least one listed row reports coordinates.
KbFeatured - the curated featured rail, folded into the Field's rows (curateFeaturedTiles, resolveFeaturedItems, and the 300-row featured pull are all gone with it).
KbTicker - the scrolling price strip. Decoration, and PUBLIC_UI.md section 5 bans motion that encodes no visitor-caused state change.

KbCommunityAlerts - replaced by CityAlertSheet. Same action, same field name, same filters, same two side effects. The `company` honeypot did not survive: V3Sheet has no hidden field kind and this page may not hand-roll a raw input.

KbAbout - the prose and the place facts moved into the first V3Quiet. The market figures that were mixed into its fact ledger (median list, active single-family, median to pending) moved to the Instrument, where they carry a source line.

buildDataDrivenCityAbout (lib/city-content.ts) - REMOVED FROM THIS ROUTE 2026-08-12, in the repair pass, not in the migration. The migration kept calling it and it published live figures inline inside a V3Quiet with no source line and no updated stamp: 'Right now the {City} market shows N active listings, a median list price of $X, N communities and subdivisions'. That is three defects in one sentence - it states the inventory count a second time directly under the V3Field that states it with a trace (this route's invariant 3), it reaches its median through `cityPulse?.medianListPrice ?? snapshot.medianListPrice` while the traced Instrument figure uses `cityPulse.medianListPrice` alone, so a missing pulse row published a median from a source the page names nowhere, and it publishes a community count that has no trace anywhere on the page. It rendered on every city with no hand-written description, which is every slug outside the getCityContent set, reachable through dynamicParams. The function is untouched and other routes may still call it; this route does not. Cost of removal, checked line by line against lib/city-content.ts: its place paragraph ('{City} is in Central Oregon. about N residents. {County} County. elevation around N.') is a prose restatement of the placeFacts rows rendered directly beneath it, and its schools paragraph restates the School district row, so no fact leaves the page - only the untraced figures and one duplicated sentence. A city with neither a written description nor a CITY_QUICK_FACTS entry now renders no About block at all rather than generated filler, which is what section 2 requires and what V3Quiet already does on its own when handed nothing.

KbMarketHud + MarketCoreCharts - the HUD's verdict stamp and KPI grid are the Instrument. The 24-month tabbed trend charts and the 60-month price history are cut from this route; the city market report at /housing-market/{slug} owns them and is linked from the Instrument's figures and the closing Quiet. getPriceHistory, getCoreChartSeries, getMarketStatsCacheRowForGeo, getRegionPulse, buildMonthlyTrend, and buildYearSeries left with them.
KbPopularSearches - a link block of pre-built search URLs. The browse door is the Instrument's action and the first closing edge.
KbAreaGuideVideo - the area-guide clip. No Stage on this page, so no owned-media section. getAreaGuideVideo left with it.
KbOpenHouses - the this-week grid. The open-houses node for this city is a closing edge. getOpenHousesWithListings and buildOpenHouseItems left with it.

KbSell - the seller CTA band, including its address prefill field. The valuation ask survives as an edge in the closing Quiet, built through valuationHref('/cities/<slug>') from lib/site/valuation-href.ts so it carries ?from=/cities/<slug>, which is the stored source_url on every seller lead this page produces. A bare /sell#get-value records the valuation page as its own origin and loses the city that produced the lead. THE RETIRED JUSTIFICATION ('the valuation ask lives in the sticky header at every scroll position') was the false premise struck in the V3Instrument entry - the header CTA is not visible at 390. The address prefill field is deleted outright and is the one capture affordance this migration does not carry across.
KbTestimonials + KbTeam - the trust cluster. ia-lock.md puts reviews and the brokers in the About destination, not on a place node.
FAQBlock - replaced by the second V3Quiet plus the faqPage entry in MetadataBlock. Same items array, same JSON-LD meaning.
MarketSources - replaced by the Oregon Data Share and U.S. Census edges in the closing Quiet, on the same condition (Census only when a population figure is printed).
SmoothScrollProvider - Lenis. The v3 register carries its own motion contract and the page no longer runs a scroll-bound sequence.
KbFooter - replaced by V3Footer.
withTimeoutFallback on every read - the four surviving reads are resilient-cached with documented fallbacks, so a timeout wrapper would only hide a real outage behind a confident empty page.

The 'Sign in to manage alerts' link inside the capture confirmation - V3Sheet's terminal step is text, not markup. The account door is in the chrome, and the confirmation still states that any alert email can pause the alert.

KbExploreTowns x3, KbCommunities, KbActivity, KbArticles - RESTORED 2026-08-12 as V3Ledger sections, not deleted. The first revision of this migration cut all six on the rhythm rule and took D80, D83, D84, D85, D88 and D93 down with them. The KB components themselves stay off this route (the barrel law and the register ratchet both forbid re-importing them); the data wiring they carried is back in full: getCommunitiesForIndex, getAllCitySnapshots, getCityCommunitySnapshots, getRecentBlogPosts, getActivityFeedWithFallbackMulti, fetchAllCityActiveSfr, resortActiveSfrCounts, resortLabelToSlug, assignNeighborhoodPhotos, RESORT_IMG, CITY_MARQUEE_COMMUNITIES, communityVideoUrl, and the bend-neighborhood-polygons import. lib/kb/neighborhood-photos.ts and lib/kb/city-page-config.ts were deleted by that revision and are restored with them - they are the lowest reusable units D88 and D89 name.

withTimeoutFallback on the four answer reads - unchanged. The SIX ledger reads ARE wrapped: a slow community index must not hold the market answer above the fold, and a ledger whose count read degraded has a defined behaviour (keep the rows, drop the value column). fetchAllCityActiveSfr uses the Result variant, because an empty array from a timeout is indistinguishable from a city with no inventory and the zero-filled count map that follows would put '0 active' under a live-MLS trace on every resort in the city.

required.emittedBy: MetadataBlock schemas array (breadcrumb entry). Home > Cities > {City}.
MetadataBlock schemas array (place entry, placeType City), additionalProperty from buildMarketFaq's datasetVariables. hasMap ships when PlaceFieldMap is in the Field slot with at least one pin.
MetadataBlock schemas array (dataset entry), variableMeasured from buildMarketFaq, dateModified from the real refresh timestamp. Emitted only when there is at least one variable.

jsonLd.note: One derivation, one answer. The visible FAQ, the FAQPage items, the Dataset variables, and the Place's additionalProperty all come from buildMarketFaq called once, fed the RAW months-of-supply value — not the rounded one an earlier revision of this note claimed. The builder classifies that raw value and renders it through formatMonthsOfSupply, which is the identical pair marketVerdict and the Instrument run, so the H1 verdict, the printed figure, the visible answer and the Months of Supply variable cannot diverge. The same rule now covers median days to pending: the Instrument prints the digits the builder publishes rather than a second rounding of them.

dataLayer.getGeoSnapshot: lib/data/geo/getGeoSnapshot.ts. NOT a plain geo_snapshot_mv read for a city, and the route file must not describe it as one. It reads geo_snapshot_mv on geo_type='city', geo_key=slug, and then applies withPulseOverride (lines 104-114, called at 147-148) on EVERY city read, replacing activeSfrCount, pendingCount, medianListPrice, and refreshedAt with the market_pulse_live row's values whenever its pulse map has a hit. That map is built by fetchPulseCityMap, which keys on BOTH geo_slug and geo_label lowercased and does not filter property_type - a broader match than this page's own getMarketPulse, which is `eq('geo_slug', geoSlug)` plus `eq('property_type','A')`. The two reads therefore fail independently, and the page cannot tell from the returned object which source won. That is why the Field's fallback source line names both sources and the rule that chooses, and confines its only negative claim to this page's own market read. Awaited first and gates notFound, so it is never null past that line. Supplies the city label, the analytics-only community count, and the fallback inventory count + median + stamp for the structured data when this page's pulse read returns nothing.
dataLayer.getMarketPulse: lib/data/market/getMarketPulse.ts. market_pulse_live, geo_type='city', geo_slug=space-separated slug, property_type='A'. 10 to 15 minute freshness. Feeds the Instrument's three figures, the Field's count when present, and buildMarketFaq. THE NO-PULSE BRANCH IS A PERMANENT PATH, NOT ONLY A DEGRADATION PATH, and that is why the source line printed there had to stop asserting what it cannot prove. Verified 2026-08-12: market_pulse_live carries 16 city rows, while middleware's CENTRAL_OREGON_CITY_SLUGS (lib/central-oregon.ts) admits 24 slugs to this route and 308-redirects every other city to /oregon/[city]. Eight admitted slugs have a geo_snapshot_mv row and no pulse row and therefore always render the fallback - alfalfa, ashwood, brothers, crooked river, gateway, mitchell, paulina, post - of which mitchell, paulina, and post carry live inventory. Two admitted slugs (tumalo, crooked river ranch) have a pulse row but no snapshot row and 404 before either branch.
dataLayer.getCityListings: lib/data/listings/getListingTiles.ts wrapper. listing_tile_mv, status active, propertyType 'A', sort newest, limit 60. The Field renders the first 24 that carry a price and a street. NOT the same population as the count above them - see the V3Field entry for the verified filters on both sides and for why the count is not swapped to a tile-derived figure.
dataLayer.getBendNeighborhoodLedger: lib/data/geo/getBendNeighborhoodLedger.ts, Bend only. Supplies the label, the active count and the median for each designated Bend district in the neighborhoods V3Ledger, under that ledger's own PLACE_COUNT_TRACE source line. (An earlier revision of this entry said its counts and medians are not printed here. They are, and they are printed in a Ledger that carries a trace, not in a Quiet.) ABSENT IS NOT ZERO ON THIS READ EITHER: it is resilient-cached with a [] fallback and also returns [] when there is no client, so an empty ledger renders every district as unmeasured rather than as thirteen zeroes under a live-MLS trace. A district omitted while the read DID answer is a measured zero, because the function drops zero-inventory districts by design. The rule lives in app/cities/[slug]/_v3/city-places.ts.
dataLayer.submitSearchAlertSignup: app/actions/search-alert-capture.ts. Bound to CityAlertSheet. Same action, same field name, same filter map, same guest-watch residual and alert_create event as the KbCommunityAlerts block it replaces.
dataLayer.note: ROUTE-LOCAL MODULES: _v3/city-constants.ts (row count, query pool, alert filter), _v3/city-field-items.ts (tile to V3FieldItem), _v3/city-sections.ts (ledger row shaping, the Instrument figures, every source trace, the stated-absence copy, the Field empty message, the closing edges), _v3/city-places.ts (the designated Bend districts), _v3/city-metadata.ts (the four JSON-LD payloads), _v3/CityAlertSheet.client.tsx (the capture). The split is ci:file-size-budget's own instruction at the 600-line floor. THE RESORT WIRING STAYS IN page.tsx DELIBERATELY: ci:resort-definitions reads that one file for resortActiveSfrCounts(slug, resortTiles), fetchAllCityActiveSfr, cityResorts(slug) and RESORT_IMG[, and a gate that stops finding its tokens stops protecting without announcing it.
